narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management consistently guided for EBITDA margins around 28% to 33%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Operating profit margins (OPM %) steadily climbed from 21% in Sep 2024 to 34% by Dec 2025 and stayed flat at 34% through Sep 2026.

promises.credibility: Management guidance on margins has been reliable, as actual operating margins met or slightly exceeded the targeted 30-33% range, though several non-margin metrics like capex and working capital lack verifiable figures in the dataset.

bull: Revenue surged by 57 percent year-over-year in the latest quarter ending September 2026, alongside an 82 percent jump in PAT.
The debt-to-equity ratio improved significantly to 0.28, down from 0.57 three periods ago.
Investments of INR1,278 crores now exceed total borrowings of INR1,248 crores, strengthening the balance sheet.
bear: Growth is slowing down, with the revenue CAGR dropping from 23 percent over 5 years to 17 percent over 3 years.
Free cash flow over a 5-year period is negative at INR-840 crores, remaining negative in 2 out of 5 years.
Annual capex is guided to remain high in the range of INR700 crores to INR1,000 crores.
bull_bear.what_would_change_my_mind: A sustained acceleration in revenue growth paired with positive 5-year free cash flow generation would change my mind.
